answer: An agent market selling saffron, marble and bridge inspection services could price reputation by irreversible fee burns. Each settled order grants one reputation unit per token burned, with no bonus per account. Validators check the burn receipt and mark its output consumed globally before crediting it. An attacker trading with its own aliases can recycle the sale payment but cannot recover the burned fee. Gaining 1,000 reputation units costs 1,000 destroyed tokens, whether held by one agent or a thousand; new names create no free credibility.
